newsitem.title: USA: VISX says FDA sets panel review for product.
newsitem.headline: VISX says FDA sets panel review for product.

text.p: VISX Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has set January 14 as the day on which an Ophthalmic Devices Advisory Panel will review VISX's Excimer Laser System for treating myopic astigmatism.

"During the July 1996 Panel Meeting, the FDA encouraged industry to submit for additional indications in order to expand the use of excimer laser correction," David Patino, Vice President of Regulatory and Clinical Affairs for VISX, said in a statement. "By taking this action, we believe the Agency has reaffirmed its commitment to expedite the regulatory process."

VISX has sold over 200 Excimer Laser Systems overseas and has been successfully treating astigmatism since 1990, it said. Systems sold in the U.S. for other uses are capable of correcting astigmatism with a simple software change.
VISX also received FDA approval in October 1996 for the expansion of VISX's U.S. clinical trials for the treatment of hyperopia (farsightedness), using the VISX STAR Excimer Laser System.
The company said early results from controlled hyperopia studies appear significantly better than those published for other available technologies.
